revision.by: fairness review (every maintained-set exam re-checked against the source)
issues: Lenient: the only content check is a mean pixel difference > 3 between input and output; it never checks that the model detected anything, although demo.py logs 'detected N instances' for each image.
`python demo.py ... | tee` under plain `set -e` ignores demo.py's exit status (later file checks happened to catch a crash); v2 uses pipefail.
Minor: the input photo is fetched from images.cocodataset.org because the repo bundles none; kept (with --retry) since the weights come from the network anyway.

Goal is fair. Note demo.py at this commit imports `vision.fair.detectron2.demo.predictor` (a Meta-internal path), so the README command fails until patched - a genuine repo defect, not an oracle problem.
evidence: demo/demo.py:113-123 - logger.info('{}: detected {} instances in {:.2f}s'); output saved to os.path.join(args.output, basename) when --output is a dir
oracles/facebookresearch-detectron2.sh - only size/diff checks; `| tee` without pipefail
